patch.comment: Fix colours set with `light-dark()` in a site build: every one was invalid, because the build rewrote the function into a form that only works in a stylesheet declaring `color-scheme` itself, which Valence does for the app. `light-dark()` now ships as written (Chrome 123, Firefox 120, Safari 17.5)

none.comment: Update the README to the NucleusKit name

Initial release of `@excom/vite-plugin-nucleus`: `nucleus()`, the Vite plugin that builds, serves and previews a Nucleus Stack site (pages, Quark modules, a bundled service worker, the Nucleus Kit bundled or loaded from unpkg), with `@excom/vite-plugin-nucleus/host` to serve a build as Cloudflare Workers static assets do and `@excom/vite-plugin-nucleus/css` for the shared CSS config
